g.title: app/client.py — runs the ledger in the caller's process and calls the same operations the HTTP routes call, as the trusted in-process principal. Eval drivers, tests, and a reasoner that embeds the ledger use it.

GET /health and the /api/v1 routes. KeyRing maps X-DecisionLedger-Key to a principal: a reasoner (bound to its reasoner_id) or the operator. Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents with a stable code (app/api/errors.py).

app/api/decisions.py, entities.py, and registrations.py, with the read-only gates.py and identity.py: the functions the routes and LocalClient both call. resolve_decision and register_reasoner are operator acts.
app/audit/store.py — writes the version-2 bundle stamped with registration_version, and opens the relationships its identity asserts in the membership projection.
decisionledger.identity_resolvers entry point named by DECISIONLEDGER_IDENTITY_RESOLVER (app/identity/resolvers.py); the passthrough (app/identity/passthrough.py) when none is configured.

Composed by app/gates.py: each plugin's build gets the framework services, the bundle store's evidence escrow among them. A gate admits each binding to it (binding_config_model, BindingValidator) at startup and when a registration is written; its evaluate(GateRequest) returns a GateOutput, which the ledger enforces; a gate that is an EvidenceVerifier answers verify. The reference gates are the rules gate and the RAG policy gate. The RAG policy gate's provider seam is its own code, which the framework never sees (policy_rag_gate/providers/, DR-34): a reasoner's binding names the corpora the gate reads for it (PolicyBindingConfig: corpus id, provider, authority tier), and the gate queries each through the RetrievalProvider that holds it (the gate's own policy_rag_gate.providers entry-point group), ranks within a corpus only, never fuses scores across corpora, and holds every answer to the evidence contract. The reference provider is pgvector + Elasticsearch + the cross-encoder reranker over the corpora the corpus loader loads.

app/reasoner_registry.py (LiveReasonerRegistry), composed at startup by app/plugins.py:build_registry from three sources: the reasoner plugins (decisionledger.reasoners), the registration file (DECISIONLEDGER_REGISTRATIONS), and PUT /api/v1/reasoners/{reasoner_id} with the operator key (register_reasoner), kept in reasoner_registry and composed again at every start. One source per reasoner: a reasoner_id two sources register refuses startup, and a PUT for a plugin's or the file's reasoner answers 409 REGISTRATION_SOURCE_IMMUTABLE. A PUT is admitted with the startup check and takes effect with the next decision. Each version is snapshotted to reasoner_registrations before it is served (app/audit/registrations.py); intake validates against the current version, replay against the bundle's registration_version.

app/audit/store.py — replay_bundle re-runs gate-level enforcement on each stored GateOutput, re-evaluates the bypass rules, and re-applies the decision-level rules and the combinator; no gate is invoked. BundleStore.replay appends the outcome to replay_logs.

app/api/decisions.py:verify_decision with app.gates.verify_evidence (DR-34). For each evidence reference of each gate that ran, two independent answers: escrow (present, missing, or none: whether the escrow holds the artifact the reference names) and status (what the gate's EvidenceVerifier answers, checking its own record and, with ?live=true, its source as it is now). A gate that is not composed, does not verify, fails, or answers late or out of contract leaves its references not_verifiable. Nothing is decided again and the bundle is unchanged; replay never asks a gate anything.

app/audit/artifacts.py (DR-34), the bundle store's (BundleStore.artifacts): the content a gate relied on while deciding, kept once in evidence_artifacts under its SHA-256, which the gate records on its evidence reference (artifact_hash). Each gate plugin's build takes it from the framework services; a gate puts from a worker thread while it evaluates, and a failed put fails the gate closed. Verify reads which artifacts it holds. DECISIONLEDGER_EVIDENCE_ESCROW=off stops writing; nothing deletes a row.

app/audit/entity_journal.py (entity_events, append-only; entity_membership, its projection) and BundleStore.entity_decisions (a subject's decisions, unioning merged ids and, on request, related subjects).
decision_bundles, replay_logs, decision_resolution_attempts, reasoner_registrations, reasoner_registry, evidence_artifacts, entity_events, entity_membership (app/audit/sql/02_tables.sql).

The reasoner must be registered; validate_submission checks the record's bypass citation, the native subject, and the gate contexts; each composed gate checks its own config_model (and ConfigAuthorizer). A failure raises SubmissionContractError before any gate runs.

Resolves the submission's native subject through the active resolver in a worker thread under a 50 ms budget (DEFAULT_IDENTITY_BUDGET_MS). Any failure gives the passthrough subject, unresolved, with the reason. It never refuses a decision.

text.tspan: (gate mode only); a failing gate fails closed

g.title: Advisory gates run only on a gated decision, and are skipped (recorded with the reason) once a mandatory gate blocks. A gate that raises, outlives its budget (45 s default), returns an unusable output, or is not composed is recorded failed and holds the decision.
app/enforcement/resolver.py — the decision-level rules, the bypass checks (snapshotted into the bundle), and the most-restrictive combinator over ALLOW < CHALLENGE < HOLD < BLOCK.
